{{Quote|I had a droid when I was younger, too. It was taken from me. Like everything else.|Third Sister, to Leia Organa|<ref name="Part IV" />}}
A '''droid''' was once owned by the [[Force-sensitive]] [[human]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Part IV" /> [[Reva Sevander]],<ref name="BTS">{{SWYouTube|ufI9DDBJVGs|Behind the Scenes of the Obi-Wan Kenobi Series!|sw_url=video/behind-the-scenes-of-the-obi-wan-kenobi-series}}</ref> though it was later taken from her.<ref name="Part IV" /> In [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Part IV]]" establishes that [[Reva Sevander]]'s [[droid]] had been taken from her prior to the events of the episode, which take place in [[9 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:KenobiDate|here]].</ref> when she interrogated [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] for information about the [[Hidden Path]], Reva, now an [[Inquisitor]] known as the Third Sister, saw Organa's own [[droid]], [[L0-LA59]], and told the princess of her droid and what had happened to it.<ref name="Part IV" />
